content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe are unavailable or unreliable, digital creators face serious hurdles in receiving payments. This is especially true in countries like Nigeria and Kenya, where Gumroad users experience payout delays. However, the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-venezuelan-creators-accepting-crypto-payments|The Full]] you're about to set up will allow you to receive crypto payments seamlessly without depending on those platforms. Utilizing NOWPayments and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-15|cloudflare]] Workers, you will create a robust payment pipeline that empowers you to control your transactions and data ownership [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/complete-deep-dive-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to complete]]ly.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment processors often fail due to regional restrictions and inconsistent service. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you bypass these limitations entirely. This solution allows you to accept payments directly in cryptocurrencies like USDT on the Tron network, where transaction fees are typically under $0.10. This approach not only eliminates payout delays but also offers you instant payment confirmations, ensuring you maintain cash flow without relying on third-party platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To get started, you will need a few key components: a Cloudflare account for hosting your payment logic, a NOWPayments account for processing crypto transactions, and a simple storage solution like Supabase for order management. Familiarity with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages will also be beneficial. Ensure you have your digital products ready for sale, as you'll need to configure your webhook to deliver these items to customers automatically upon payment confirmation.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by creating a Cloudflare Worker that listens for incoming payment notifications from NOWPayments. Configure your webhook to trigger when a payment is confirmed, which will communicate with Supabase to store the order details. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing your digital products so that they can be delivered directly to customers via a secure link. This setup enables a fully automated payment and delivery process, eliminating the need for manual intervention.
Take control of your payment processing with no platform dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is set up, it's time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Worker and ensure that your webhook URL is correctly configured in your NOWPayments dashboard. Test the entire flow by making a small transaction using USDT on the Tron network. Verify that the payment is processed, and an email is sent with the download link for your digital product. This first transaction will confirm that your infrastructure is functioning as expected and ready to handle real customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your infrastructure is live and you have successfully processed initial transactions, consider scaling your operation. Use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to expand your setup by adding more products or enhancing your delivery mechanisms. Monitor transaction patterns and customer feedback to optimize your offerings. Automate further processes, such as customer support via email or chatbots, to maintain efficiency as your sales increase.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up a NOWPayments account linked to your Cloudflare Worker. This allows you to automate payment confirmations and product delivery. Compared to PayPal, USDT payments on the Tron network settle almost instantly with negligible fees, ensuring you get paid in real time.
Instant payment confirmations mean you get paid without delays.

If you're interested in maximizing your earning potential, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a more comprehensive setup. This stack not only streamlines your payment processing but also enhances your product delivery capabilities. For detailed guides and resources, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?
Set up a NOWPayments account and configure a webhook with Cloudflare Workers. This allows you to automate payment confirmations and deliver products directly to customers.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments on the Tron network settle almost instantly, typically within seconds, while PayPal can take several days to process payouts, especially in certain regions.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Creators can use peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia for converting Bitcoin to naira. These platforms facilitate direct transactions between users, providing better rates.
What are the transaction fees for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% on each transaction, making it a cost-effective solution for processing crypto payments without additional hidden charges.
Can I integrate more payment options later?
Yes, your infrastructure is designed to be flexible. You can easily integrate additional payment options or cryptocurrencies in the future as your business scales.
